thread:
amir: quick heads-up: planning a telemetry reprocess for NA aggregate windows (2026-03-14 -> 2026-03-16). aiming to start 04:00 UTC tomorrow. console will default to preview/dry-run. want quick eyes on routing + quota assumptions.

frank: +1. can we make the default concurrency low (2) and shard routing conservative? last big reprocess spiked IO.

tasha: also, product asked for a preview mode that shows row-level sample diffs (not full diff) so we don't overwhelm them. small sample size checkbox?

yun: API note: there are two entrypoints. /internal/reprocess.v1.Start enforces tenant quotas and emits per-tenant metrics. console proxy adds UX features but bypasses some quota checks. for canaries use internal.

amir: ok will wire canary runs through internal.

console-bot: reprocess-scheduler: queued job id=job-na-1758889999-1 shards=8 dry_run=true concurrency=2 route=spot_preferred

frank: route=spot_preferred worries me for canary tenants. request: override to reserved for tenants with paid-plan=true. can we auto-detect?

yun: we have tenant metadata in routing service. will add a quick override flag --prefer-reserved-for-paid. trivial change.

tasha: abort threshold proposal: if sampled diffs > 3% for a tenant in preview, stop and notify #product-telemetry. also auto-open an infra ticket with snapshot link.

amir: agree. i'll implement preview-snapshot S3 path and add ticket payload. sample CLI i'll run: 
``
/reprocess start --region na --from 2026-03-14T00:00Z --to 2026-03-16T00:00Z --shards 8 --concurrency 2 --dry-run --preview-sample=1000 --prefer-reserved-for-paid
```

ops-bot: notice: infra maintenance 03:30-04:30 UTC (NA-west). jobs hitting window will be paused and resumed.

amir: set job timeout to 75m so we don't get left mid-commit. add resume-validation: re-run small checksum diff after resume. if checksum mismatch > 0.5% compared to pre-pause, send PagerDuty.

frank: logging/metrics: please ensure we emit tags: reprocess.run_id, reprocess.preview=true|false, reprocess.client=console. need these so dashboards don't mix preview runs with full runs.

yun: will add metrics. also we should record quota.reject_count on start to catch any proxy bypass mistakes.

tasha: UX ask: on the run page show a tiny pill "Canary -> internal API" when internal is used, and tooltip that says "bypasses console proxy quotas". saves support confusion.

amir: will add pill + link to runbook. final checklist: 1) yun adds flag for reserved routing 2) me implements preview-snapshot & abort 3) frank updates runbook and volunteers to eyeball sample diffs for tenant=beta 4) tasha updates console copy.

console-bot: reprocess-scheduler: dry-run started id=job-na-1758889999-1 canary=true
